typeThemeDesc: Theme plugins and color presets for DSH; authors specify supported interfaces and dependencies.
typeThemeStep1: Check whether this is a theme plugin or a preset that needs a parent plugin, and review the supported DSH versions and interface.
typeThemeStep2: Preview compatibility for themes with a pinned npm release, then install through the official installer. Follow the README for palette selection and settings.
typeThemeStep3: After applying, check text, inputs and dialogs, and confirm that disabling the theme restores the previous appearance.
emptyThemesHelp: No themes match these filters. Use Share resource to recommend one with attribution, source, dependencies and screenshots.
themeSubmissionNote: In the content, describe the theme plugin or preset, supported DSH versions and interface, parent plugin, light/dark appearance, application and restoration steps. Mark untested behavior.
discoverSubtitle: Find extensions for your task. Review the content and choose how to use it.
hostReadError: Host plugin status is temporarily unavailable.
hostIncomplete: Some presets could not be read; these results are incomplete.
hostStatusNote: Matches module names in the host and presets. Configured does not mean running or available in this conversation. This view does not modify plugins.
typePluginStep1: Check the host status to see whether this module is already included in the host or a conversation preset.
typePluginStep2: Read the author's README for the DSH version, dependencies and configuration. Existing modules usually do not need another installation.
typePluginStep3: Preview installation and confirm the pinned version and permissions. Installation, version replacement and removal use the official DSH CLI. Restart the host and refresh the page when required.
typeSkillStep1: Read the author's SKILL.md, including the task scope, scripts and supporting files.
typeSkillStep2: Choose Install to DSH and review the files before installing their original bytes. Configure script dependencies using the author’s instructions.
typeSkillStep3: Check that the default preset has loaded the Skill, then select it in a new conversation. Existing conversations may need to reconnect.
typeMCPStep1: Check the author's documentation for the endpoint, transport and runtime requirements.
typeMCPStep2: Choose Configure and connect MCP, review the transport and fill in required parameters or credentials. Confirm to save it in the current profile.
typeMCPStep3: After tools are registered, make a real call to confirm connectivity. Disable or remove the connection in the market. Downloading a definition alone does not connect.
typeSlashStep1: Identify the parent plugin. Slash commands share its installation.
typeSlashStep2: Check the parent module's host status and read the command documentation.
typeSlashStep3: Confirm the command and arguments before running it in the current conversation. The parent plugin determines side effects and model calls; your input draft is preserved.
typePromptStep1: Read the author's prompt and check that it fits your task.
typePromptStep2: Choose “Use in current conversation”, fill in variables if needed, or download the Markdown.
typePromptStep3: Review the conversation input before sending it yourself. Your existing draft is preserved.

extStateNote: “Entry loaded” confirms entry activation, not every feature. Restart DSH after installation, updates or removal.

extResult-recovery-required: The profile needs recovery review; further writes are blocked. Use the operation ID to inspect local logs and backups.

extCheck-negotiated: Required protocols match; runtime behavior unverified
extCheck-adapter-required: Install and load the adapter first
extCheck-route-required: Runtime entry cannot yet be selected safely

sourceStarted: Source check started; you can keep browsing
sourceDescription_dsh: Reads packages and commands pinned to the current 0.1.5-rc.2 host.
sourceDescription_skills: Scans top-level Skill directories with reviewed licenses and complete file manifests.
sourceDescription_mcp: Pages through current active servers and keeps supported stdio or Streamable HTTP definitions.
sourceDescription_npm: Discovers author-tagged dsh-plugin, dsh-theme and dsh-std packages. Installation checks their actual manifests.
sourceDescription_skills-openai: Scans public curated Skills; host-internal system Skills are excluded.
sourceDescription_community: Syncs the six-type resource index after community submissions pass review and merge.
starRankingScope: Stars fetched for {known}/{total} repositories. Only known counts are ranked; unread repositories follow. Show more to fetch more counts. This is not a marketplace-wide leaderboard.
commandNotice: The current session plugin executes this command and may use the selected model. Existing drafts and attachments are preserved.
commandChanged: The session changed. Review the command again.
commandMissing: This session does not provide this command. Check its plugin.
resourceIncomplete: Resource details are incomplete. The saved copy is unchanged.
savedChanged: The saved copy changed. Select the update again.
skillInstallNotice: Files go into the DSH user Skill directory with original content and licenses. Installation does not run bundled scripts; an existing directory blocks installation. Read the author’s instructions and dependencies before use.
skillEmpty: No Skills installed through this market yet.
skillUse: In a new conversation, type /{name}, select the Skill and add your task. Sending uses the conversation model. Existing conversations may need a reconnect to refresh cached suggestions.
skillState-installed: Files installed; host loading not detected
skillState-shadowed: Another Skill with the same name takes priority
skillNoFiles: This resource has no installable Skill files
mcpEmpty: No MCP connections configured through this market.
mcpConnectNotice: Connection settings are saved in local DSH configuration. HTTP connects to the declared service; npm downloads and starts the pinned program. Credentials are not sent to the community. Connection checks do not call a model; actual use follows the service’s authorization and pricing.
mcpManageNotice: This changes only the market-managed connection. Disabling stops the connection; removal does not delete server data.
extIssue-theme-startup: This theme version failed frontend startup on DSH 0.1.5-rc.2; installation is blocked.
extIssue-theme-contrast: This theme reduces the host’s New session label contrast to about 1.04:1. The market works, but the label has a readability issue.
mcpState-registered: Tools registered; current connectivity needs an actual call
extToggleNotice: This saves enable/disable intent for every identifiable native entry of this package and keeps installed files. Restart DSH and reopen the page to verify; existing pages may retain old styles.
skillManageNotice: Enable/disable preserves original files. Updates verify the full new bundle and retain the old version. Removal retains a recovery copy. Check a new conversation; existing conversations may cache old instructions.
skillRestoreNotice: Check owned recovery records and restore a removed copy, previous version or pre-interruption state. External modifications stop recovery. Without a recovery copy, existing files stay unchanged.
npmDownloadTooltip: Downloads for npm package {name} from {start} to {end}, across all versions; not marketplace installations or unique users.
historyReadError: History could not be read. Refresh to retry.
operationBlocked: Profile writes are paused until the previous operation is resolved. Check its backup and log using the operation ID.
operationHistoryNote: Shows the latest 20 operations. Raw logs and backups remain in community/operations under your DSH home. This page does not unlock or overwrite the profile.
operationEmpty: No installation or configuration operations yet.
withdrawalNote: Reviewed removal requests apply across sources. Failed refreshes keep the previous policy. Users retain control of existing copies and installations.
extIssue-theme-interaction: This version can switch palettes, but opening its panel with a mouse failed and it repeatedly requested a missing local endpoint. Review the known limitations.
requirementsNativeSkill: Installation places original files in the DSH user Skill directory. Configure script and tool dependencies using the author’s instructions, then check that the host has loaded the Skill.
requirementsOpenAiSkill: Original files from Codex Skills can be installed. Host tools, MCP services, environment variables and script dependencies still need configuration; installing the files does not satisfy those dependencies.
requirementsNativePackage: Targets DSH 0.1.5-rc.2. Check whether the host already includes this module, then preview its pinned version and dependencies before confirming installation.
standard-adoption-reloads-all: Managing standard components for the first time changes adapter discovery and may immediately reload every standard component in this profile. Restart DSH and refresh the page after confirming, then check their behavior.
standard-restart-required: This saves the enabled state for the next startup. Restart DSH and refresh the page to confirm it. Dependency failures or adapter reloads can also trigger reinitialization.
